_about: Texts of the history pages (history/<slug>.html), built by tools/history/build.py. 'common' and 'pages.<slug>' are keyed by the short hash (7 characters) of the site's commit; a page's own text wins over a common one. 'aliases' points a commit to another one's text. 'pages.<slug>.retired.<hash>' keeps the Last changes summaries that commit took off the page, in the three languages. 'pages.<slug>.note' adds a line under the history's introduction. A commit that changes a page's media but has no text here still appears, with its English subject.

en.label: 15 Nov 2026
en.title: Elephants and macaques that move
en.text: On the Angkor circuits the elephants flap their ears, swing their trunks and tails and sway, the howdah and mahout moving with them; the macaques glance about and groom, and a juvenile tears round in a ring. The animation runs on the graphics card, so a herd costs nothing more to draw. The aerial flyover also became a film — 73 s over 8 monuments with 6 animal shots on the Petit Circuit, 87 s over 10 with 7 on the Grand — while the shorter flyover before a race now adds a troop of macaques and a cow elephant with her calf.

en.label: 15 Nov 2026
en.title: Angkor laid out from surveyed data
en.text: Both circuits are now laid out from OpenStreetMap and a satellite land-cover map instead of by eye: enclosure walls, moats, ponds, rivers and 749 buildings stand where they are, and jungle, grass and rice grow where the satellite sees them. Several temples moved to their true places — Preah Khan’s enclosure was 100 m off — the rice fields left the wrong roads, and an invented pagoda and two invented houses were removed. On a Galaxy A56 the forest was tuned to run at 56.7 frames per second on the Petit Circuit and 55.2 on the Grand.

en.label: 14 Nov 2026
en.title: Seven languages
en.text: The game now speaks French, Khmer, simplified Chinese, Vietnamese, Thai and Russian as well as English. It follows the phone’s language and can be switched under Settings → Language, with the change applied at once. On the Angkor circuits the temples carry their local names in each language.

en.label: 14 Nov 2026
en.title: A photographic Angkor and an aerial intro
en.text: The two Angkor circuits took on a photographic look: a photographed sky that lights the scene, photo-scanned ground and stone, carved relief panels in 16 Khmer motifs, and every monument rebuilt in far more detail. The buggy got a rally-raid cockpit and photo materials on every stage. Each Angkor race now opens with drone shots over the temples, down to the start line; a tap skips them.

en.label: 12–13 Nov 2026
en.title: From one Angkor stage to two circuits
en.text: A sixth stage, Angkor Temples, arrived with rice paddies, Angkor Wat, the Bayon and Ta Prohm, open from the start. The next day it gave way to the Petit Circuit and the Grand Circuit, on the real roads at 1:2.5 (7.1 and 10.2 km), with about 35 monuments rebuilt from researched dimensions. Best times set on the old courses were cleared; the stars were kept.

en.label: 12 Nov 2026
en.title: Easier to drive
en.text: The game’s first version, under the name Dustline Rally, had five stages. The same day, steering was matched to the grip under the front wheels, phones with a motion sensor started on tilt steering, a steering assist (off, low or high) began following the bends when the driver lets go, and the time limits gained room for a beginner: 173 s instead of 156 on the first stage. Fences, hedges, spectators and 46 new scenery models now line the courses.

fr.label: 15 nov. 2026
fr.title: Des éléphants et des macaques qui bougent
fr.text: Sur les circuits d’Angkor, les éléphants battent des oreilles, balancent trompe et queue et se dandinent, palanquin et cornac compris ; les macaques jettent des coups d’œil et s’épouillent, et un jeune galope en rond. L’animation tourne sur la carte graphique : un troupeau ne coûte rien de plus à afficher. Le survol aérien devient aussi un film — 73 s au-dessus de 8 monuments avec 6 plans d’animaux sur le Petit Circuit, 87 s au-dessus de 10 avec 7 sur le Grand —, et le survol plus court avant une course ajoute une troupe de macaques et une éléphante avec son petit.

fr.label: 15 nov. 2026
fr.title: Angkor tracé d’après des relevés
fr.text: Les deux circuits sont désormais tracés d’après OpenStreetMap et une carte satellite d’occupation des sols, et non plus à l’œil : enceintes, douves, bassins, rivières et 749 bâtiments sont à leur place, et jungle, prairies et rizières poussent là où le satellite les voit. Plusieurs temples ont rejoint leur vraie position — l’enceinte de Preah Khan était décalée de 100 m —, les rizières ont quitté les mauvaises routes, et une pagode et deux maisons inventées ont disparu. Sur un Galaxy A56, la forêt a été réglée pour tourner à 56,7 images par seconde sur le Petit Circuit et 55,2 sur le Grand.

fr.label: 14 nov. 2026
fr.title: Sept langues
fr.text: Le jeu parle désormais français, khmer, chinois simplifié, vietnamien, thaï et russe en plus de l’anglais. Il suit la langue du téléphone, et l’on peut en changer dans Réglages → Langue, avec effet immédiat. Sur les circuits d’Angkor, les temples portent leur nom local dans chaque langue.

fr.label: 14 nov. 2026
fr.title: Un Angkor photographique et une intro aérienne
fr.text: Les deux circuits d’Angkor prennent un rendu photographique : un ciel photographié qui éclaire la scène, sol et pierre issus de scans photo, des panneaux sculptés sur 16 motifs khmers, et chaque monument reconstruit avec bien plus de détails. Le buggy reçoit un cockpit de rallye-raid et des matériaux photo sur toutes les étapes. Chaque course à Angkor s’ouvre désormais sur des plans de drone au-dessus des temples, jusqu’à la ligne de départ ; un appui suffit pour les passer.

fr.label: 12–13 nov. 2026
fr.title: D’une étape d’Angkor à deux circuits
fr.text: Une sixième étape, Angkor Temples, est arrivée avec ses rizières, Angkor Vat, le Bayon et Ta Prohm, ouverte d’emblée. Dès le lendemain, elle a laissé place au Petit Circuit et au Grand Circuit, sur les vraies routes à l’échelle 1:2,5 (7,1 et 10,2 km), avec environ 35 monuments reconstruits d’après leurs dimensions réelles. Les meilleurs temps des anciens parcours ont été effacés ; les étoiles sont restées.

fr.label: 12 nov. 2026
fr.title: Plus facile à piloter
fr.text: La première version du jeu, sous le nom de Dustline Rally, comptait cinq étapes. Le jour même, la direction a été calée sur l’adhérence des roues avant, les téléphones à capteur de mouvement sont passés par défaut à la direction par inclinaison, une aide à la direction (désactivée, faible ou forte) s’est mise à suivre les virages quand le pilote lâche, et les temps limites ont laissé de la marge aux débutants : 173 s au lieu de 156 sur la première étape. Barrières, haies, spectateurs et 46 nouveaux éléments de décor bordent désormais les parcours.

en.label: 20 Nov 2026
en.title: Engine smoke, sparks and grinding
en.text: A damaged engine smokes from 25 % damage, light grey at first, thick and black near the end. Sparks now fly from the point where the car is hit, not always from the nose, and sliding along a wall or scraping the underside on hard ground throws a steady spray of sparks with a metal grinding sound. This works at every effects level.

en.label: 20 Nov 2026
en.title: Hard steering tightens the line
en.text: With the throttle and full steering held, as on a phone’s buttons, the car used to keep accelerating through a tight corner and run wide. Above about 30 km/h, hard steering now eases off the engine and the tyres scrub off speed: from 90 km/h the car turns on a radius of about 32 m instead of 68 m.

en.label: 19 Nov 2026
en.title: People and animals get out of the way
en.text: Monks, tourists, villagers, macaques, dogs, pigs, poultry and egrets step, run or fly out of the path of any car. When the player’s car comes too fast for them it knocks them: a person falls and gets up, a small animal rolls and runs off, a bird flies up, and the car loses some speed and takes a dent. Elephants and the other big animals stay solid, and the elephants trumpet; the spectators, now modelled people, watch the cars, cheer and step aside instead of being obstacles.

en.label: 19 Nov 2026
en.title: Elephants, bikes and the cockpit view
en.text: The elephants were reshaped: thin cupped ears, legs that flare into the body, toenails, a trunk tip with its finger, the belly at an Asian elephant’s height, one grey hide with folds behind the shoulder, cracked and creased from Medium effects up. The scooter and the moto now lean into the bends; they used to lean out. In the cockpit view the eye sits in the rider’s head on the two-wheelers and the tuk-tuk, and the 4x4s’ dark glass no longer blacks out the windscreen.

en.label: 19 Nov 2026
en.title: Traffic on the Angkor roads
en.text: Races can now have road traffic, none, light or dense, chosen with the circuit: 4x4s in the road lanes both ways, scooters, motos and tuk-tuks in the slow lanes by the edge. The player’s car hits what it drives into, and knocked vehicles shake, honk and keep their dents. Each traffic level keeps its own records and allows 7 % more time; traffic is not yet in multiplayer races or in the films.

en.label: 18–19 Nov 2026
en.title: Sponsor boards over and along the road
en.text: The scoring gates became road-wide boards for The Moon Kampot and Chantrea Systems on two lattice masts, and the checkpoints now stand under the same boards. Every roadside billboard carries the two sponsors, turned to face the road, with no wall, plant or house in front of the print. Each film has a shot under a gantry and past each sponsor’s billboard, rises over every temple of its circuit and names it, and its three cars no longer drive through one another.

fr.label: 20 nov. 2026
fr.title: Fumée, étincelles et raclements
fr.text: Un moteur endommagé fume dès 25 % de dégâts, d’un gris clair d’abord, puis d’une fumée noire et épaisse vers la fin. Les étincelles jaillissent désormais du point d’impact, et non plus toujours de l’avant, et frotter un mur ou racler le soubassement sur un sol dur projette une gerbe continue d’étincelles, avec un grincement de métal. C’est vrai à tous les niveaux d’effets.

fr.label: 20 nov. 2026
fr.title: Braquer fort resserre la trajectoire
fr.text: Accélérateur et direction à fond, comme avec les boutons d’un téléphone, la voiture continuait d’accélérer dans un virage serré et sortait large. Au-dessus d’environ 30 km/h, un fort braquage coupe désormais un peu les gaz et les pneus freinent la voiture : lancée à 90 km/h, elle tourne sur un rayon d’environ 32 m au lieu de 68 m.

fr.label: 19 nov. 2026
fr.title: Gens et animaux s’écartent
fr.text: Moines, touristes, villageois, macaques, chiens, cochons, volailles et aigrettes s’écartent, détalent ou s’envolent devant n’importe quelle voiture. Si la voiture du joueur arrive trop vite, elle les heurte : une personne tombe et se relève, un petit animal roule et s’enfuit, un oiseau s’envole, et la voiture perd un peu de vitesse et prend une bosse. Les éléphants et les autres grands animaux restent solides, et les éléphants barrissent ; les spectateurs, désormais modelés, suivent les voitures, les acclament et s’écartent au lieu d’être des obstacles.

fr.label: 19 nov. 2026
fr.title: Éléphants, deux-roues et vue cockpit
fr.text: Les éléphants ont été remodelés : oreilles fines en coquille, pattes qui s’évasent dans le corps, ongles, bout de trompe avec son doigt, ventre à la hauteur de celui d’un éléphant d’Asie, une seule peau grise plissée derrière l’épaule, craquelée et ridée dès les effets Moyen. Le scooter et la moto se penchent désormais vers l’intérieur des virages ; ils penchaient vers l’extérieur. En vue cockpit, l’œil est dans la tête du pilote sur les deux-roues et le tuk-tuk, et les vitres sombres des 4x4 ne noircissent plus le pare-brise.

fr.label: 19 nov. 2026
fr.title: De la circulation sur les routes d’Angkor
fr.text: Les courses peuvent désormais avoir de la circulation, nulle, légère ou dense, choisie avec le circuit : des 4x4 sur les voies de la route dans les deux sens, scooters, motos et tuk-tuks sur les voies lentes au bord. La voiture du joueur heurte ce qu’elle percute, et les véhicules touchés tremblent, klaxonnent et gardent leurs bosses. Chaque niveau de circulation a ses propres records et accorde 7 % de temps en plus ; la circulation n’est pas encore présente dans les courses multijoueur ni dans les films.

fr.label: 18–19 nov. 2026
fr.title: Des sponsors au-dessus et au bord de la route
fr.text: Les portes de points sont devenues des panneaux sur toute la largeur de la route pour The Moon Kampot et Chantrea Systems, portés par deux mâts en treillis, et les points de contrôle se trouvent sous les mêmes panneaux. Tous les panneaux du bord de la route portent les deux sponsors, tournés vers la route, sans mur, plante ni maison devant l’affiche. Chaque film a un plan sous un portique et devant le panneau de chaque sponsor, s’élève au-dessus de chaque temple de son circuit en le nommant, et ses trois voitures ne se traversent plus.

km.label: 19 វិច្ឆិកា 2026
km.title: មនុស្ស និងសត្វចៀសចេញពីផ្លូវ
km.text: ព្រះសង្ឃ ភ្ញៀវទេសចរ អ្នកភូមិ ស្វា ឆ្កែ ជ្រូក មាន់ទា និងសត្វក្រសា ដើរចៀស រត់ ឬហើរចេញពីផ្លូវរបស់រថយន្តណាក៏ដោយ។ បើរថយន្តរបស់អ្នកលេងមកលឿនពេក វាបុកពួកគេ៖ មនុស្សដួល ហើយក្រោកឡើងវិញ សត្វតូចរមៀល ហើយរត់ចេញ បក្សីហើរឡើង ហើយរថយន្តបាត់បង់ល្បឿនខ្លះ និងមានស្នាមផត។ ដំរី និងសត្វធំៗផ្សេងទៀតនៅរឹងមាំដដែល ហើយដំរីស្រែកបន្លឺសំឡេង។ អ្នកទស្សនា ដែលឥឡូវជាមនុស្សបានឆ្លាក់គំរូ មើលតាមរថយន្ត អបអរ ហើយដើរចៀស ជំនួសឱ្យការក្លាយជាឧបសគ្គ។

km.title: ដំរី ម៉ូតូ និងទិដ្ឋភាពពី cockpit
km.text: ដំរីត្រូវបានកែរូបរាងឡើងវិញ៖ ត្រចៀកស្តើងកោងដូចសំបក ជើងដែលរីកធំចូលទៅក្នុងខ្លួន ក្រចកជើង ចុងប្រមោយដែលមានម្រាមរបស់វា ពោះនៅកម្ពស់ដូចដំរីអាស៊ី និងស្បែកពណ៌ប្រផេះតែមួយ ដែលមានជ្រួញនៅពីក្រោយស្មា ហើយប្រេះ និងជ្រួញចាប់ពីបែបផែនកម្រិតមធ្យម។ ម៉ូតូស្កូទ័រ និងម៉ូតូ ឥឡូវទ្រេតចូលទៅខាងក្នុងផ្លូវបត់ ខណៈពីមុនវាទ្រេតទៅខាងក្រៅ។ ក្នុងទិដ្ឋភាពពី cockpit នៅលើម៉ូតូ និងតុកតុក ភ្នែកកាមេរ៉ាស្ថិតនៅក្នុងក្បាលអ្នកជិះ ហើយកញ្ចក់ងងឹតរបស់រថយន្ត 4x4 លែងធ្វើឱ្យកញ្ចក់ខាងមុខខ្មៅងងឹតទៀតហើយ។

en.label: 19 Nov 2026
en.title: Siem Reap’s old quarter and the towns
en.text: The colonial quarter round the Old Market is drawn as published sources describe it: two-storey shophouses in white, pastel or brighter renovated colours under shared terracotta tiled roofs, with colonnaded galleries opening in arches, balconies, and round-headed windows with louvred shutters. The Old Market is a one-floor hall, the Grand Hotel d’Angkor has four floors under a hipped tiled roof, and the quarter’s restaurants and bars put tables out on the pavement. Across the towns, shophouses now line only the main roads and named streets; the 17,915 buildings inside the blocks are two-storey detached houses.

en.label: 19 Nov 2026
en.title: The Bayon from its survey drawings
en.text: The Bayon now has a model built from the EFEO’s drawings: the 108 written spot heights of its levelling plan set each platform and court at its level, and a 1/50 axial section gives the towers, the central one 29.6 m above the sanctuary’s floor. It holds the central tower and the axial towers, the inner gallery’s sixteen towers and the twelve towers of the courts, the outer gallery’s 375 free-standing pillars, the axial stairs, the outer gopuras with their porches, stairs and walls, the four corner pavilions and the two libraries. The towers’ faces are not modelled yet.

en.label: 18–19 Nov 2026
en.title: Angkor Wat, part by part
en.text: Angkor Wat rebuilt from the EFEO’s survey drawings: the central massif, the second level, the gallery of the bas-reliefs, the west entrance and the causeways, and the fourth enclosure with its north and south gopuras, its stone drawn to the measured sizes of its courses. The last additions are the cloister’s stair halls with their piers and stepped roofs. Automated checks now catch flights hidden in the stone or blocked at their foot, pillars that carry nothing and roofs that rest on nothing; 40 flights were cleared at their foot.

en.label: 16–17 Nov 2026
en.title: Modelled vehicles, traffic and weather
en.text: The world is now built at 1:1 everywhere. The car, two-wheelers, auto-rickshaw and remorque are modelled, with their drivers, riders and passengers and speedometers that work, and traffic drives the roads round the player, two-wheelers leaning into bends and vehicles taking turns at junctions. Clouds and their shadows, rain rings on water, spray from the wheels, street and vehicle lamps, road markings, pavements, bridges and the everyday objects of streets and villages were added.

fr.label: 19 nov. 2026
fr.title: Le vieux quartier de Siem Reap et les villes
fr.text: Le quartier colonial autour du Vieux Marché est dessiné tel que le décrivent les sources publiées : compartiments à deux niveaux, blancs, pastel ou repeints de couleurs vives, sous des toits de tuiles en terre cuite partagés, avec galeries à colonnes ouvertes en arcs, balcons et hautes fenêtres cintrées à persiennes. Le Vieux Marché est une halle de plain-pied, le Grand Hotel d’Angkor compte quatre niveaux sous un toit de tuiles à croupes, et les restaurants et bars du quartier sortent leurs tables sur le trottoir. Dans les villes, les compartiments ne bordent plus que les grands axes et les rues nommées ; les 17 915 bâtiments du cœur des îlots sont devenus des maisons individuelles à deux niveaux.

fr.label: 19 nov. 2026
fr.title: Le Bayon d’après ses relevés
fr.text: Le Bayon a désormais un modèle tiré des dessins de l’EFEO : les 108 cotes écrites de son plan de nivellement placent chaque terrasse et chaque cour à sa hauteur, et une coupe axiale au 1/50 donne les tours, la tour centrale à 29,6 m au-dessus du sol du sanctuaire. On y trouve la tour centrale et les tours axiales, les seize tours de la galerie intérieure et les douze tours des cours, les 375 piliers isolés de la galerie extérieure, les escaliers axiaux, les gopuras extérieurs avec leurs porches, leurs escaliers et leurs murs, les quatre pavillons d’angle et les deux bibliothèques. Les visages des tours ne sont pas encore modélisés.

fr.label: 18–19 nov. 2026
fr.title: Angkor Vat, partie par partie
fr.text: Angkor Vat reconstruit d’après les relevés de l’EFEO : le massif central, le deuxième niveau, la galerie des bas-reliefs, l’entrée ouest et les chaussées, et la quatrième enceinte avec ses gopuras nord et sud, la pierre dessinée aux dimensions mesurées de ses assises. Derniers ajouts : les salles d’escalier du cloître, avec leurs piles et leurs toits en gradins. Des contrôles automatiques repèrent désormais les volées enfouies dans la pierre ou bloquées à leur pied, les piliers qui ne portent rien et les toits qui ne reposent sur rien ; 40 volées ont été dégagées à leur pied.

fr.label: 16–17 nov. 2026
fr.title: Véhicules modélisés, circulation et météo
fr.text: Le monde est désormais construit à l’échelle 1:1 partout. La voiture, les deux-roues, le tricycle motorisé et la remorque sont modélisés, avec conducteurs, pilotes et passagers et des compteurs de vitesse qui fonctionnent, et une circulation parcourt les routes autour du joueur : les deux-roues se penchent dans les virages, les véhicules passent chacun leur tour aux carrefours. S’y ajoutent les nuages et leurs ombres, les ronds de pluie sur l’eau, les gerbes d’eau derrière les roues, les réverbères et les feux des véhicules, le marquage au sol, les trottoirs, les ponts et les objets du quotidien des rues et des villages.

km.label: 19 វិច្ឆិកា 2026
km.title: សង្កាត់ចាស់ក្រុងសៀមរាប និងទីក្រុងនានា
km.text: សង្កាត់សម័យអាណានិគម នៅជុំវិញផ្សារចាស់ ត្រូវបានគូរតាមការពិពណ៌នានៃឯកសារដែលបានបោះពុម្ព៖ ផ្ទះល្វែងពីរជាន់ ពណ៌ស ពណ៌ស្រាល ឬពណ៌ភ្លឺៗ ដែលទើបជួសជុល ក្រោមដំបូលក្បឿងដីដុតរួមគ្នា ជាមួយច្រកដើរមានសសរ ដែលបើកជាក្លោងធ្នូ យ៉ និងបង្អួចខ្ពស់ក្បាលមូល មានស្លឹកបង្អួចជាបន្ទះៗ។ ផ្សារចាស់ ជាសាលមួយជាន់ សណ្ឋាគារ Grand Hotel d’Angkor មានបួនជាន់ ក្រោមដំបូលក្បឿងជម្រាលបួនទិស ហើយភោជនីយដ្ឋាន និងបារនៃសង្កាត់នេះ ដាក់តុនៅលើចិញ្ចើមផ្លូវ។ នៅក្នុងទីក្រុងនានា ឥឡូវផ្ទះល្វែងមានតែតាមបណ្តោយផ្លូវធំៗ និងផ្លូវដែលមានឈ្មោះប៉ុណ្ណោះ ហើយអគារ 17 915 នៅខាងក្នុងប្លុក បានក្លាយជាផ្ទះពីរជាន់ដាច់ដោយឡែក។

km.label: 19 វិច្ឆិកា 2026
km.title: ប្រាសាទបាយ័ន ពីប្លង់វាស់វែងរបស់វា
km.text: ឥឡូវនេះ ប្រាសាទបាយ័នមានគំរូ ដែលសាងសង់ពីប្លង់របស់ EFEO៖ ចំណុចកម្ពស់ដែលសរសេរ 108 នៃប្លង់វាស់កម្ពស់របស់វា កំណត់កម្រិតនៃរាន និងទីធ្លានីមួយៗ ហើយផ្នែកកាត់តាមអ័ក្ស មាត្រដ្ឋាន 1/50 ផ្តល់កំពូលទាំងឡាយ ដែលកំពូលកណ្តាលមានកម្ពស់ 29.6 ម៉ែត្រ ពីលើកម្រាលនៃប្រាសាទកណ្តាល។ គំរូនេះមាន៖ កំពូលកណ្តាល និងកំពូលតាមអ័ក្ស កំពូលដប់ប្រាំមួយនៃរោងខាងក្នុង និងកំពូលដប់ពីរនៃទីធ្លា សសរឈរដាច់ដោយឡែក 375 នៃរោងខាងក្រៅ ជណ្តើរតាមអ័ក្ស ខ្លោងទ្វារខាងក្រៅ ជាមួយរានហាល ជណ្តើរ និងជញ្ជាំងរបស់វា អាគារនៅជ្រុងទាំងបួន និងបណ្ណាល័យទាំងពីរ។ ព្រះភក្ត្រនៅលើកំពូល មិនទាន់មាននៅក្នុងគំរូនៅឡើយទេ។

km.title: អង្គរវត្ត មួយផ្នែកម្តងៗ
km.text: ប្រាសាទអង្គរវត្ត ត្រូវបានសាងសង់ឡើងវិញពីប្លង់វាស់វែងរបស់ EFEO៖ តួប្រាសាទកណ្តាល ជាន់ទីពីរ រោងចម្លាក់ ច្រកចូលខាងលិច និងផ្លូវថ្ម និងកំពែងទីបួន ជាមួយខ្លោងទ្វារខាងជើង និងខាងត្បូង ដោយថ្មត្រូវបានគូរតាមទំហំស្រទាប់ថ្មដែលបានវាស់។ ការបន្ថែមចុងក្រោយ គឺសាលជណ្តើរនៃព្រះពាន់ ជាមួយសសរទ្រ និងដំបូលជាថ្នាក់ៗ។ ការត្រួតពិនិត្យស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ ឥឡូវរកឃើញជណ្តើរដែលលាក់ក្នុងថ្ម ឬត្រូវបានរាំងនៅជើង សសរដែលមិនទ្រអ្វី និងដំបូលដែលមិនសង្កត់លើអ្វី ហើយជណ្តើរ 40 ត្រូវបានដោះការរាំងនៅជើងរបស់វា។

km.label: 16–17 វិច្ឆិកា 2026
km.title: គំរូយានយន្ត ចរាចរណ៍ និងអាកាសធាតុ
km.text: ឥឡូវនេះ ពិភពលោកត្រូវបានសាងសង់តាមមាត្រដ្ឋាន 1:1 គ្រប់ទីកន្លែង។ រថយន្ត ម៉ូតូ ម៉ូតូស្កូទ័រ រ៉ឺម៉កកង់បី និងរ៉ឺម៉កខ្មែរ មានគំរូរបស់វា ជាមួយអ្នកបើកបរ អ្នកជិះ អ្នកដំណើរ និងនាឡិកាល្បឿនដែលដំណើរការ ហើយចរាចរណ៍បើកបរនៅលើផ្លូវជុំវិញអ្នកលេង ដោយម៉ូតូផ្អៀងពេលបត់ និងយានយន្តផ្លាស់វេនគ្នានៅផ្លូវប្រសព្វ។ ពពក និងស្រមោលរបស់វា រង្វង់ភ្លៀងលើទឹក ទឹកខ្ទាតពីកង់ ចង្កៀងផ្លូវ និងចង្កៀងយានយន្ត គំនូសសញ្ញាលើផ្លូវ ចិញ្ចើមផ្លូវ ស្ពាន និងវត្ថុប្រចាំថ្ងៃតាមផ្លូវ និងក្នុងភូមិ ក៏ត្រូវបានបន្ថែមផងដែរ។

en.label: 21 Nov 2026
en.title: Phnom Bakheng, Pre Rup, the East Mebon and Bakong from the EFEO’s sheets
en.text: Four temple-mountains rebuilt from their survey sheets: Phnom Bakheng’s five tiers and upper platform at their levelled heights, its 60 small sandstone towers, its four axial stairways flight by flight and its central tower, measured at 6.77 m; Pre Rup’s tiers and towers at the heights of the 1969 sheets; the East Mebon’s four levels and five towers from its 1969 sections; Bakong’s tiers, central tower and twelve small towers from the 1940 plan.

en.label: 21 Nov 2026
en.title: Siem Reap by night, and the French quarter
en.text: In the old quarter the bars light their signs at night, and Pub Street gets its overhead signs and strings of lights; the riverside and the Royal Gardens are baked by day and at night; Wat Preah Prom Rath becomes a walled garden with stupas and palms; the French administrative quarter gets its villas on planted plots.

en.label: 20–21 Nov 2026
en.title: First models of Banteay Kdei, Prasat Kravan and Prasat Bei
en.text: Banteay Kdei from the EFEO’s sheets: the central sanctuary, the galleries and pavilions of its enclosures, the hall of dancers, its gopuras, the cruciform terrace and the face tower of the east gate. Prasat Kravan’s five brick towers as restored, measured from their 1963 to 1965 sections; Prasat Bei’s platform and three towers as surveyed in 1965.

en.label: 20 Nov 2026
en.title: Chau Say Tevoda, Neak Pean and the Bayon’s face towers
en.text: Chau Say Tevoda’s central group and four gopuras, the ruin the EFEO drew in 1968; Neak Pean’s island, tower and four chapels, with the stepped banks of its pools; the eight face towers round the Bayon’s central tower, from the 1945 plan.

en.label: 19–20 Nov 2026
en.title: Banteay Srei from the EFEO drawings
en.text: Banteay Srei now has a model built from the EFEO’s plan d’ensemble at 1/100 and its sheets at 1/20 and 1/50: the T-shaped platform with its three sanctuaries and the mandapa, the two libraries, the east gopuras of its three enclosures, the laterite walls of the second and third, and the east approach from gopura IV, with its avenue, galleries and two of its buildings. What the drawings show as ruins is built as ruins, each wall to the height still standing. Where the drawings differ from Glaize’s published figures, the difference is recorded.

en.label: 19–20 Nov 2026
en.title: First buildings of Preah Khan and Ta Prohm
en.text: Preah Khan’s first buildings, from EFEO sheets of 1956 to 1967: the outer enclosure’s north gopura with its three towers and galleries, the hall of dancers with its 75 pillars, the two-storey columned building of the third enclosure, and a library of the north cloister. At Ta Prohm, the outer enclosure’s north gopura, a face tower with two wings, is built to its sheet’s figures; the rest of the temple stays as mapped, as the archive holds no section of its galleries.

fr.label: 21 nov. 2026
fr.title: Phnom Bakheng, Pre Rup, le Mébon oriental et Bakong d’après les planches de l’EFEO
fr.text: Quatre temples-montagnes reconstruits d’après leurs relevés : les cinq gradins et la plateforme supérieure de Phnom Bakheng à leurs hauteurs nivelées, ses 60 petites tours de grès, ses quatre escaliers axiaux volée par volée et sa tour centrale, mesurée à 6,77 m ; les gradins et les tours de Pre Rup aux hauteurs des planches de 1969 ; les quatre niveaux et les cinq tours du Mébon oriental d’après ses coupes de 1969 ; les gradins, la tour centrale et les douze petites tours de Bakong d’après le plan de 1940.

fr.label: 21 nov. 2026
fr.title: Siem Reap la nuit, et le quartier français
fr.text: Dans le vieux quartier, les bars allument leurs enseignes la nuit et Pub Street reçoit ses enseignes suspendues et ses guirlandes lumineuses ; les berges de la rivière et les Jardins royaux sont précalculés de jour comme de nuit ; le Wat Preah Prom Rath devient un jardin clos avec ses stupas et ses palmiers ; le quartier administratif français reçoit ses villas sur des parcelles plantées.

fr.label: 20–21 nov. 2026
fr.title: Premiers modèles de Banteay Kdei, Prasat Kravan et Prasat Bei
fr.text: Banteay Kdei d’après les planches de l’EFEO : le sanctuaire central, les galeries et les pavillons de ses enceintes, la salle des danseuses, ses gopuras, la terrasse cruciforme et la tour à visages de la porte est. Les cinq tours de brique de Prasat Kravan telles que restaurées, mesurées d’après leurs coupes de 1963 à 1965 ; la plateforme et les trois tours de Prasat Bei telles que relevées en 1965.

fr.label: 20 nov. 2026
fr.title: Chau Say Tevoda, Neak Pean et les tours à visages du Bayon
fr.text: Le groupe central et les quatre gopuras de Chau Say Tevoda, la ruine que l’EFEO a dessinée en 1968 ; l’île, la tour et les quatre chapelles de Neak Pean, avec les berges en gradins de ses bassins ; les huit tours à visages autour de la tour centrale du Bayon, d’après le plan de 1945.

fr.label: 19–20 nov. 2026
fr.title: Banteay Srei d’après les relevés de l’EFEO
fr.text: Banteay Srei a désormais un modèle tiré du plan d’ensemble de l’EFEO au 1/100 et de ses planches au 1/20 et au 1/50 : la plateforme en T avec ses trois sanctuaires et le mandapa, les deux bibliothèques, les gopuras est de ses trois enceintes, les murs de latérite de la deuxième et de la troisième, et l’allée d’accès est depuis le gopura IV, avec ses galeries et deux de ses bâtiments. Ce que les dessins montrent en ruine est bâti en ruine, chaque mur à la hauteur qu’il conserve. Là où les relevés s’écartent des chiffres publiés par Glaize, l’écart est consigné.

fr.label: 19–20 nov. 2026
fr.title: Premiers bâtiments de Preah Khan et de Ta Prohm
fr.text: Les premiers bâtiments de Preah Khan, d’après des planches de l’EFEO de 1956 à 1967 : le gopura nord de l’enceinte extérieure, avec ses trois tours et ses galeries, la salle des danseuses et ses 75 piliers, le bâtiment à colonnes et à étage de la troisième enceinte, et une bibliothèque du cloître nord. À Ta Prohm, le gopura nord de l’enceinte extérieure, une tour à visages flanquée de deux ailes, est bâti selon les cotes de sa planche ; le reste du temple demeure tel que cartographié, les archives n’ayant aucune coupe de ses galeries.

km.title: អគារដំបូងនៃព្រះខ័ន និងតាព្រហ្ម
km.text: អគារដំបូងនៃប្រាសាទព្រះខ័ន ពីប្លង់របស់ EFEO ឆ្នាំ 1956 ដល់ 1967៖ ខ្លោងទ្វារខាងជើងនៃកំពែងខាងក្រៅ ជាមួយកំពូលទាំងបី និងរោងរបស់វា សាលរបាំ ជាមួយសសរ 75 អគារសសរមូលពីរជាន់ នៃកំពែងទីបី និងបណ្ណាល័យមួយនៃព្រះពាន់ខាងជើង។ នៅប្រាសាទតាព្រហ្ម ខ្លោងទ្វារខាងជើងនៃកំពែងខាងក្រៅ ដែលជាកំពូលព្រះភក្ត្រមានស្លាបពីរ ត្រូវបានសាងសង់តាមតួលេខនៃប្លង់របស់វា។ ផ្នែកផ្សេងទៀតនៃប្រាសាទនៅតែដូចលើផែនទី ព្រោះបណ្ណសារមិនមានផ្នែកកាត់នៃរោងរបស់វាទេ។

en: The Bayon’s faces and forty-five monuments

The page catches up with the repository: forty-five monuments or parts of monuments now have a model, and a new section shows the Bayon’s thirty-one towers with their faces carved as reliefs, its upper terrace and its own stone, and the gates of Angkor Thom with the South Gate’s causeway. Eight new captures, updated code and test figures, and Last changes now run to 23 November.
fr: Les visages du Bayon et quarante-cinq monuments

La page rattrape le dépôt : quarante-cinq monuments ou parties de monuments ont désormais un modèle, et une nouvelle section montre les trente et une tours du Bayon et leurs visages sculptés en relief, sa terrasse supérieure et sa propre pierre, ainsi que les portes d’Angkor Thom et la chaussée de la porte Sud. en.label: 20 Nov 2026
en.title: A country team with narrower rights
en.text: A “Country team” group gives platform staff the data of their own countries and the moderation work; verifying, rejecting, approving, suspending or hiding now needs the right to change, not just to view. In the administration, invoices and links to companies, people, places and countries stay within the staff member’s countries, and only a super-administrator can change a company’s verification status and subscription or change and delete staff accounts. A security review also limited each list of the new platform dashboard to staff allowed to see it, and HTML e-mails turn only the site’s own addresses into links.

en.label: 19–20 Nov 2026
en.title: A waiting list for full departures
en.text: On the site and in the app, a customer can join the waiting list of a full departure. Seats that free up are held for the first request that fits, announced by notification, push and e-mail, and passed to the next person when the offer expires; when a company raises a departure’s capacity, the new seats go to the waiting list first. Companies see who is waiting and how many seats are held, and their dashboard now shows how full each activity is, with a CSV export of departures that holds no amounts and no customer details.

en.label: 19 Nov 2026
en.title: Declared returns, overdue alerts and GPS tracks
en.text: The crew or the shore team declare when a trip leaves, how many people are on board and when it is back; if a boat is not back after its planned end plus a margin, they get a single alert with the captain’s phone number. From the app, the crew can record the trip’s GPS track, kept even without a network and shown in the professional space; tracks are deleted after a year, and the area map and the itinerary can be saved before leaving for offline use. A “My company” space in the app gives the shore team the day’s bookings, payment on site with a receipt, messages and the boats at sea, late ones first — all presented as a management aid, never as a distress device.

en.label: 19 Nov 2026
en.title: Ports and services, favourites and messages
en.text: Companies can propose listings for marinas, pontoons, moorings, boatyards, fuel and chandlery; the platform team reviews them, and anyone can search them by type, service, text or distance, on the site and in the app. Customers can keep favourite activities, rentals and boats for sale, and exchange messages with the company about a booking until 30 days after the trip. A written procedure and an end-to-end test with Thailand (baht, Bangkok time, 7% VAT) show that a new country opens without code changes; planned countries stay hidden from the public.

en.label: 19 Nov 2026
en.title: Lighter photos, browser tests and launch preparation
en.text: Every photo now has a 480 px and a 1280 px version, lists load their small images only when needed, and public API answers are cached for a minute, never for a signed-in request. Browser tests (Playwright) follow the main journeys on a computer and a phone, now also in CI; they led to a fix for the header and the professional space overflowing a phone screen, and an automated check finds no WCAG 2.1 AA violation on the main pages. For the launch, the site has a privacy policy and a legal notice in five languages, a sitemap and sharing previews, and the app has its store listings in five languages.

en.label: 18–19 Nov 2026
en.title: The mobile app, notifications and invoices
en.text: The Flutter app for Android and iOS arrived with activities, boat rental, quotes, boats for sale, reviews and the map; bookings and the crew’s passenger lists stay readable without a network. An inbox of notifications, on the site and in the app and also sent as push notifications, opens the screen concerned. Companies now issue invoices and credit notes numbered without gaps, and anyone can delete their own account from the site or the app.

fr.label: 20 nov. 2026
fr.title: Une équipe pays aux droits resserrés
fr.text: Un groupe « Country team » donne à l’équipe de la plateforme les données de ses propres pays et la modération ; vérifier, rejeter, approuver, suspendre ou masquer exige désormais le droit de modifier, et non plus seulement celui de voir. Dans l’administration, les factures et les liens vers les entreprises, les personnes, les lieux et les pays restent limités aux pays de l’équipier, et seul un super-administrateur peut changer le statut de vérification et l’abonnement d’une entreprise, ou modifier et supprimer les comptes de l’équipe. Une revue de sécurité a aussi réservé chaque liste du nouveau tableau de bord de la plateforme à ceux qui ont le droit de la voir, et les courriels HTML ne transforment en liens que les adresses du site.

fr.label: 19–20 nov. 2026
fr.title: Une liste d’attente pour les départs complets
fr.text: Sur le site et dans l’application, on peut s’inscrire sur la liste d’attente d’un départ complet. Les places libérées sont retenues pour la première demande qui tient, annoncées par notification, push et courriel, puis proposées à la suivante si l’offre expire ; quand une entreprise augmente la capacité d’un départ, les nouvelles places vont d’abord à la liste d’attente. Les entreprises voient qui attend et combien de places sont retenues, et leur tableau de bord montre désormais le remplissage de chaque activité, avec un export CSV des départs sans montants ni données de clients.

fr.label: 19 nov. 2026
fr.title: Retours déclarés, alertes de retard et traces GPS
fr.text: L’équipage ou l’équipe à terre déclarent le départ d’une sortie, le nombre de personnes à bord et le retour ; si un bateau n’est pas rentré après la fin prévue plus une marge, ils reçoivent une seule alerte avec le téléphone du capitaine. Depuis l’application, l’équipage peut enregistrer la trace GPS de la sortie, conservée même sans réseau et consultable dans l’espace professionnel ; les traces sont effacées au bout d’un an, et la carte de la zone et l’itinéraire peuvent être enregistrés avant le départ pour un usage hors connexion. Dans l’application, l’espace « Mon entreprise » donne à l’équipe à terre les réservations du jour, l’encaissement sur place avec reçu, les messages et les bateaux en mer, retards en tête — le tout présenté comme une aide à la gestion, jamais comme un moyen de détresse.

fr.label: 19 nov. 2026
fr.title: Ports et services, favoris et messages
fr.text: Les entreprises peuvent proposer des fiches de marinas, pontons, mouillages, chantiers, carburant et accastillage ; l’équipe de la plateforme les relit, et chacun peut les chercher par type, service, texte ou proximité, sur le site et dans l’application. Les clients gardent en favoris des activités, des locations et des bateaux à vendre, et échangent des messages avec l’entreprise au sujet d’une réservation jusqu’à 30 jours après la sortie. Une procédure écrite et un test de bout en bout avec la Thaïlande (bahts, heure de Bangkok, TVA à 7 %) montrent qu’un nouveau pays s’ouvre sans toucher au code ; les pays prévus restent invisibles du public.

fr.label: 19 nov. 2026
fr.title: Photos allégées, tests de navigateur et préparation du lancement
fr.text: Chaque photo existe désormais en 480 px et en 1280 px, les listes ne chargent leurs vignettes qu’au besoin, et les réponses publiques de l’API sont réutilisables pendant une minute, jamais pour une requête authentifiée. Des tests de navigateur (Playwright) suivent les parcours principaux sur ordinateur et sur téléphone, désormais aussi en CI ; ils ont fait corriger l’en-tête et l’espace professionnel qui débordaient de l’écran d’un téléphone, et un contrôle automatique ne relève aucune violation WCAG 2.1 AA sur les pages principales. Pour le lancement, le site a une politique de confidentialité et des mentions légales en cinq langues, un plan du site et des aperçus de partage, et l’application ses fiches pour les magasins en cinq langues.

fr.label: 18–19 nov. 2026
fr.title: L’application mobile, les notifications et les factures
fr.text: L’application Flutter pour Android et iOS est arrivée avec les activités, la location de bateaux, les devis, les bateaux à vendre, les avis et la carte ; les réservations et les listes de passagers de l’équipage restent lisibles sans réseau. Une boîte de réception des notifications, sur le site et dans l’application, doublée de notifications push, ouvre l’écran concerné. Les entreprises émettent désormais des factures et des avoirs à numérotation continue, et chacun peut supprimer son propre compte depuis le site ou l’application.

km.title: បញ្ជីរង់ចាំសម្រាប់ការចេញដំណើរដែលពេញ
km.text: នៅលើគេហទំព័រ និងក្នុងកម្មវិធី អតិថិជនអាចចុះឈ្មោះក្នុងបញ្ជីរង់ចាំនៃការចេញដំណើរដែលពេញហើយ។ កៅអីដែលទំនេរវិញ ត្រូវបានរក្សាទុកសម្រាប់សំណើដំបូងដែលត្រូវនឹងចំនួនកៅអីនោះ ដោយជូនដំណឹងតាមប្រអប់ការជូនដំណឹង push និងអ៊ីមែល ហើយត្រូវបានផ្តល់ទៅអ្នកបន្ទាប់ នៅពេលការផ្តល់ជូនផុតកំណត់ ហើយនៅពេលក្រុមហ៊ុនបង្កើនចំនួនកៅអីនៃការចេញដំណើរមួយ កៅអីថ្មីទៅបញ្ជីរង់ចាំមុនគេ។ ក្រុមហ៊ុនឃើញអ្នកដែលកំពុងរង់ចាំ និងចំនួនកៅអីដែលបានរក្សាទុក ហើយផ្ទាំងគ្រប់គ្រងរបស់ពួកគេឥឡូវបង្ហាញកម្រិតពេញនៃសកម្មភាពនីមួយៗ ជាមួយការនាំចេញ CSV នៃការចេញដំណើរ ដោយគ្មានចំនួនទឹកប្រាក់ ឬព័ត៌មានអតិថិជន។

km.label: 19 វិច្ឆិកា 2026
km.title: ការប្រកាសការត្រឡប់មកវិញ ការជូនដំណឹងពេលយឺត និងផ្លូវ GPS
km.text: នាវិក ឬក្រុមនៅលើគោក ប្រកាសពេលដំណើរចេញ ចំនួនមនុស្សនៅលើទូក និងពេលត្រឡប់មកវិញ ហើយប្រសិនបើទូកមិនទាន់ត្រឡប់មកវិញ ក្រោយម៉ោងបញ្ចប់ដែលគ្រោងទុក បូករយៈពេលបន្ថែមមួយ ពួកគេទទួលបានការជូនដំណឹងតែមួយដង ជាមួយលេខទូរស័ព្ទរបស់ប្រធានទូក។ ពីកម្មវិធី នាវិកអាចកត់ត្រាផ្លូវ GPS នៃដំណើរ ដែលរក្សាទុកបាន ទោះគ្មានបណ្តាញក៏ដោយ ហើយមើលបានក្នុងផ្នែកសម្រាប់អ្នកជំនាញ ផ្លូវទាំងនេះត្រូវបានលុបក្រោយមួយឆ្នាំ ហើយផែនទីតំបន់ និងផ្លូវធ្វើដំណើរ អាចរក្សាទុកមុនចេញដំណើរ ដើម្បីមើលដោយគ្មានបណ្តាញ។ ក្នុងកម្មវិធី ផ្នែក “ក្រុមហ៊ុនរបស់ខ្ញុំ” ផ្តល់ឱ្យក្រុមនៅលើគោក នូវការកក់ប្រចាំថ្ងៃ ការទទួលប្រាក់នៅនឹងកន្លែងជាមួយបង្កាន់ដៃ សារ និងទូកដែលកំពុងនៅលើទឹក ដោយទូកដែលយឺតនៅខាងលើគេ — ទាំងអស់នេះបង្ហាញជាជំនួយក្នុងការគ្រប់គ្រង មិនដែលជាឧបករណ៍ជូនដំណឹងគ្រោះអាសន្នទេ។

km.label: 19 វិច្ឆិកា 2026
km.title: កំពង់ផែ និងសេវាកម្ម ចំណូលចិត្ត និងសារ
km.text: ក្រុមហ៊ុនអាចស្នើព័ត៌មានអំពីកំពង់ចតទូក ផែ កន្លែងចតយុថ្កា រោងជាងទូក ប្រេងឥន្ធនៈ និងបរិក្ខារទូក ដែលក្រុមវេទិកាពិនិត្យ ហើយអ្នកណាក៏អាចស្វែងរកវាតាមប្រភេទ សេវាកម្ម អត្ថបទ ឬចម្ងាយ នៅលើគេហទំព័រ និងក្នុងកម្មវិធី។ អតិថិជនអាចរក្សាទុកសកម្មភាព ការជួល និងទូកសម្រាប់លក់ដែលខ្លួនចូលចិត្ត ហើយផ្ញើសារទៅក្រុមហ៊ុនអំពីការកក់មួយ រហូតដល់ 30 ថ្ងៃក្រោយដំណើរ។ នីតិវិធីជាលាយលក្ខណ៍អក្សរ និងការធ្វើតេស្ត end-to-end ជាមួយប្រទេសថៃ (ប្រាក់បាត ម៉ោងបាងកក VAT 7%) បង្ហាញថា ប្រទេសថ្មីអាចបើកបានដោយមិនចាំបាច់កែកូដ ចំណែកប្រទេសដែលគ្រោងទុក នៅតែមើលមិនឃើញសម្រាប់សាធារណជន។

km.label: 19 វិច្ឆិកា 2026
km.title: រូបថតស្រាលជាងមុន ការធ្វើតេស្តលើ browser និងការរៀបចំដាក់ឱ្យដំណើរការ
km.text: រូបថតនីមួយៗឥឡូវមានកំណែ 480 px និង 1280 px បញ្ជីផ្ទុករូបតូចៗតែនៅពេលត្រូវការ ហើយចម្លើយសាធារណៈរបស់ API អាចប្រើឡើងវិញបានរយៈពេលមួយនាទី តែមិនដែលសម្រាប់សំណើដែលបានចូលគណនីទេ។ ការធ្វើតេស្តលើ browser (Playwright) ដើរតាមដំណើរការសំខាន់ៗ លើកុំព្យូទ័រ និងទូរស័ព្ទ ហើយឥឡូវដំណើរការក្នុង CI ផងដែរ ការធ្វើតេស្តទាំងនេះបាននាំឱ្យកែក្បាលទំព័រ និងផ្នែកសម្រាប់អ្នកជំនាញ ដែលធំជាងអេក្រង់ទូរស័ព្ទ ហើយការពិនិត្យស្វ័យប្រវត្តិមិនរកឃើញការបំពាន WCAG 2.1 AA ណាមួយ លើទំព័រសំខាន់ៗទេ។ សម្រាប់ការដាក់ឱ្យដំណើរការ គេហទំព័រមានគោលការណ៍ឯកជនភាព និងព័ត៌មានផ្លូវច្បាប់ ជា 5 ភាសា ផែនទីគេហទំព័រ (sitemap) និងរូបមើលជាមុនពេលចែករំលែក ហើយកម្មវិធីមានព័ត៌មានសម្រាប់ store ជា 5 ភាសា។

km.label: 18–19 វិច្ឆិកា 2026
km.title: កម្មវិធីទូរស័ព្ទ ការជូនដំណឹង និងវិក្កយបត្រ
km.text: កម្មវិធី Flutter សម្រាប់ Android និង iOS បានមកដល់ ជាមួយសកម្មភាព ការជួលទូក សំណើតម្លៃ ទូកសម្រាប់លក់ ការវាយតម្លៃ និងផែនទី ហើយការកក់ និងបញ្ជីអ្នកដំណើររបស់នាវិក នៅតែអាចអានបានដោយគ្មានបណ្តាញ។ ប្រអប់ការជូនដំណឹង នៅលើគេហទំព័រ និងក្នុងកម្មវិធី ដែលក៏ផ្ញើជាការជូនដំណឹង push ផងដែរ បើកអេក្រង់ដែលពាក់ព័ន្ធ។ ឥឡូវក្រុមហ៊ុនចេញវិក្កយបត្រ និងប័ណ្ណឥណទាន ដែលមានលេខរៀងបន្តគ្នាដោយគ្មានចន្លោះ ហើយម្នាក់ៗអាចលុបគណនីរបស់ខ្លួនពីគេហទំព័រ ឬកម្មវិធី។

en: Seven languages

The page catches up with the repository: Vietnamese and Lao bring the platform to seven languages; official emergency numbers and the companies’ safety instructions, scooters, motorbikes, quads and buggies for rent, accessibility checks on the site and in the app, the app’s tablet layout, demo photos with their credits, and the new figures (214 API operations, 593 API tests, 143 app tests). Last changes now run to 23 November 2026.
fr: Sept langues

La page rattrape le dépôt : le vietnamien et le lao portent la plateforme à sept langues ; les numéros d’urgence officiels et les consignes de sécurité des entreprises, la location de scooters, motos, quads et buggies, les contrôles d’accessibilité du site et de l’application, la mise en page tablette de l’application, les photos de la démo et leurs crédits, et les nouveaux chiffres (214 opérations d’API, 593 tests de l’API, 143 tests de l’application). Les Derniers changements vont désormais jusqu’au 23 novembre 2026.
km: 7 ភាសា

ទំព័រនេះធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពតាម repository៖ ភាសាវៀតណាម និងឡាវ នាំវេទិកាឱ្យមាន 7 ភាសា លេខសង្គ្រោះបន្ទាន់ផ្លូវការ និងការណែនាំសុវត្ថិភាពរបស់ក្រុមហ៊ុន ការជួលម៉ូតូស្កូតឺ ម៉ូតូ quad និង buggy ការពិនិត្យភាពងាយស្រួលប្រើលើគេហទំព័រ និងក្នុងកម្មវិធី ប្លង់ tablet របស់កម្មវិធី រូបថតសាកល្បង និងឥណទានរបស់វា និងតួលេខថ្មី (ប្រតិបត្តិការ API 214 ការធ្វើតេស្ត API 593 ការធ្វើតេស្តកម្មវិធី 143)។ ការផ្លាស់ប្តូរចុងក្រោយ ឥឡូវរហូតដល់ថ្ងៃទី 23 ខែវិច្ឆិកា ឆ្នាំ 2026។

Ce site reçoit sa propre page, en anglais, en français et en khmer, avec des captures prises en local sur le site.

The page now counts nine games and 23 presentation pages.
fr: Neuf jeux, 23 pages
La page compte désormais neuf jeux et 23 pages de présentation.

en.title: Renamed Chantrea Systems
en.text: The site took a new name on every page: the brand, the footer and the page titles. First renamed The Moon Studio, it became Chantrea Systems later the same day.

en.title: A page for each project
en.text: Nine projects get a presentation page, from Synth Rack and VSM Studio to HMS and this website, on the model of the game pages; each states plainly what is unfinished. Projects without screenshots show command-line examples instead, and Velocity joins the Games.

fr.label: 18 nov. 2026
fr.title: Le site devient Chantrea Systems

fr.label: 13 nov. 2026
fr.title: Une page pour chaque projet
fr.text: Neuf projets reçoivent une page de présentation, de Synth Rack et VSM Studio à HMS et ce site, sur le modèle des pages de jeux ; chacune dit clairement ce qui n’est pas terminé. Les projets sans captures montrent à la place des exemples en ligne de commande, et Velocity rejoint les jeux.

fr.label: 11–12 nov. 2026
fr.title: Les pages de jeux, en khmer aussi
fr.text: Chaque jeu reçoit sa page de présentation, ouverte depuis sa carte, et le lendemain les pages de jeux sont traduites en khmer. L’accueil gagne la section Derniers changements, avec les 20 derniers commits groupés par jour, et ses sections se suivent désormais ainsi : À propos, Jeux, Sound Lab, Projets, Photos, Derniers changements, Contact.

en.label: 13–14 Nov 2026
en.title: Company accounts and split folios
en.text: The hotel can bill companies directly: at departure the balance is transferred to the company with an invoice in its name, its payments settle the oldest invoices first, and the amounts owed are shown by age, with a statement in PDF in the company’s language. The folio of a stay billed to a company can be split so that the company pays the room and the guest the extras, each part with its own payments, invoice and receipts.

en.label: 13 Nov 2026
en.title: End of day, recovery codes and photos
en.text: An end-of-day screen lists the open items, then the day report and the cash-up; closing the day saves a PDF and freezes that day’s charges and payments. Two-factor sign-in is set up with a QR code, comes with ten one-time recovery codes, and can be made compulsory for a role. Photos of rooms, facilities and repair requests, and the hotel logo, are re-encoded on upload and stored in the database, and the logo now appears on invoices, receipts, folios and the other documents.

fr.label: 13–14 nov. 2026
fr.title: Comptes entreprises et notes partagées
fr.text: L’hôtel peut facturer directement une entreprise : au départ, le solde lui est transféré avec une facture à son nom, ses paiements soldent d’abord les factures les plus anciennes, et les sommes dues sont classées par ancienneté, avec un relevé en PDF dans la langue de l’entreprise. La note d’un séjour facturé à une entreprise peut être partagée : l’entreprise paie la chambre, le client les extras, chaque partie avec ses paiements, sa facture et ses reçus.

fr.label: 13 nov. 2026
fr.title: Clôture de la journée, codes de secours et photos
fr.text: Un écran de clôture liste les points en suspens, puis le rapport du jour et l’état de caisse ; clôturer enregistre un PDF et fige les prestations et les paiements de la journée. La double authentification s’active par QR code, fournit dix codes de secours à usage unique et peut être rendue obligatoire pour un rôle. Les photos des chambres, des installations et des demandes de réparation, ainsi que le logo de l’hôtel, sont réencodés à l’envoi et conservés dans la base, et le logo figure désormais sur les factures, les reçus, les notes et les autres documents.

en: Seventy lessons and a Translate page

The page catches up with the repository: 70 lessons up to 23 January 2027, 700 words and expressions, 12,471 MP3 clips now that every lesson is recorded in the seven languages, and the Translate page, the only one that needs the Internet. Last changes now run to 21 November 2026.
fr: Soixante-dix leçons et une page Traduire

La page rattrape le dépôt : 70 leçons jusqu’au 23 janvier 2027, 700 mots et expressions, 12 471 fichiers MP3 maintenant que chaque leçon est enregistrée dans les sept langues, et la page Traduire, la seule qui a besoin d’Internet. Les Derniers changements vont désormais jusqu’au 21 novembre 2026.
km: មេរៀន 70 និងទំព័របកប្រែ

ទំព័រនេះធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពតាម repository៖ មេរៀន 70 រហូតដល់ថ្ងៃទី 23 ខែមករា ឆ្នាំ 2027 ពាក្យ និងឃ្លា 700 ឯកសារ MP3 12 471 ដោយមេរៀននីមួយៗមានសំឡេងគ្រប់ 7 ភាសា និងទំព័របកប្រែ ដែលជាទំព័រតែមួយគត់ដែលត្រូវការអ៊ីនធឺណិត។ ការផ្លាស់ប្តូរចុងក្រោយ ឥឡូវរហូតដល់ថ្ងៃទី 21 ខែវិច្ឆិកា ឆ្នាំ 2026។

en: Its own presentation page

TubeGuard gets a page of its own, in English, French and Khmer. It is for personal use and not distributed, and its built-in ad blocking cannot be guaranteed, as its repository says. The repository has no screenshots, so the page shows command-line examples.

TubeGuard reçoit sa propre page, en anglais, en français et en khmer. Il est réservé à un usage personnel et n’est pas distribué, et son blocage intégré des publicités ne peut pas être garanti, comme le dit son dépôt. Le dépôt n’a pas de captures : la page montre des exemples en ligne de commande.
km: ទំព័របង្ហាញផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន

en: Its own presentation page

Vigie gets a page of its own, in English, French and Khmer, in the In development section: what it does, how matching and priorities work, client isolation, notifications, news, operations and where it stands, with Last changes running to 26 November 2026 (lot 18). Eight captures of a demo database, those the Chantrea Systems website publishes, show its screens.
fr: Sa page de présentation

Vigie reçoit sa propre page, en anglais, en français et en khmer, dans la section En développement : ce qu’il fait, le fonctionnement de la correspondance et des priorités, le cloisonnement, les notifications, les actualités, l’exploitation et l’état du projet, avec des Derniers changements qui vont jusqu’au 26 novembre 2026 (lot 18). Huit captures d’une base de démonstration, celles que publie le site de Chantrea Systems, montrent ses écrans.
km: ទំព័របង្ហាញផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន

Vigie ទទួលបានទំព័រផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន ជាភាសាអង់គ្លេស បារាំង និងខ្មែរ នៅក្នុងផ្នែកកំពុងអភិវឌ្ឍ៖ អ្វីដែលវាធ្វើ របៀបដែលការផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់ និងអាទិភាពដំណើរការ ការបំបែកទិន្នន័យអតិថិជន ការជូនដំណឹង ព័ត៌មាន ប្រតិបត្តិការ និងស្ថានភាពបច្ចុប្បន្ន ជាមួយការផ្លាស់ប្តូរចុងក្រោយរហូតដល់ថ្ងៃទី 26 ខែវិច្ឆិកា ឆ្នាំ 2026 (ដំណាក់កាលទី 18)។ រូបថតអេក្រង់ប្រាំបីនៃមូលដ្ឋានទិន្នន័យសាកល្បង ដែលគេហទំព័រ Chantrea Systems ផ្សព្វផ្សាយ បង្ហាញអេក្រង់របស់វា។

en: Its own presentation page

Chantrea Odoo gets a page of its own in the Projects section, in English, French and Khmer: the idea, the Odoo, OCA and in-house modules, the client area, what is specific to Cambodia (riels, KHQR checked with Bakong, Khmer numerals, the Khmer review), security and operations, and where it stands, with Last changes running to 25 November 2026. The repository publishes no screenshots, so a diagram of its architecture stands in for them.
fr: Sa page de présentation

Chantrea Odoo reçoit sa propre page dans la section Projets, en anglais, en français et en khmer : le principe, les modules d’Odoo, de l’OCA et maison, l’espace client, ce qui est propre au Cambodge (riels, KHQR vérifié auprès de Bakong, chiffres khmers, relecture du khmer), la sécurité et l’exploitation, et l’état du projet, avec des Derniers changements qui vont jusqu’au 25 novembre 2026. Le dépôt ne publie pas de captures : un schéma de son architecture en tient lieu.
km: ទំព័របង្ហាញផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន

Chantrea Odoo ទទួលបានទំព័រផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន នៅក្នុងផ្នែកគម្រោង ជាភាសាអង់គ្លេស បារាំង និងខ្មែរ៖ គំនិតដើម module របស់ Odoo, OCA និង module ផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន តំបន់អតិថិជន អ្វីដែលពិសេសសម្រាប់កម្ពុជា (ប្រាក់រៀល KHQR ដែលផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់ជាមួយ Bakong លេខខ្មែរ និងការពិនិត្យភាសាខ្មែរ) សុវត្ថិភាព និងប្រតិបត្តិការ និងស្ថានភាពបច្ចុប្បន្ន ជាមួយការផ្លាស់ប្តូរចុងក្រោយរហូតដល់ថ្ងៃទី 25 ខែវិច្ឆិកា ឆ្នាំ 2026។ ឃ្លាំងកូដមិនផ្សព្វផ្សាយរូបថតអេក្រង់ទេ ដូច្នេះដ្យាក្រាមនៃស្ថាបត្យកម្មរបស់វា ត្រូវបានប្រើជំនួស។

en: Nine captures

Nine captures on the demo data, taken on a local installation on 26 November: the client area in Khmer on a computer and a phone, its requests and equipment, an English invoice with its riel totals and KHQR code, a Khmer and English tax invoice, and the French back office.
fr: Neuf captures

Neuf captures sur les données de démonstration, prises sur une installation locale le 26 novembre : l’espace client en khmer sur ordinateur et sur téléphone, ses demandes et son matériel, une facture en anglais avec ses totaux en riels et son code KHQR, une facture de TVA en khmer et en anglais, et le back-office en français.
km: រូបថតអេក្រង់ប្រាំបួន

រូបថតអេក្រង់ប្រាំបួនលើទិន្នន័យសាកល្បង ដែលថតលើការដំឡើងក្នុងម៉ាស៊ីន នៅថ្ងៃទី 26 ខែវិច្ឆិកា៖ តំបន់អតិថិជនជាភាសាខ្មែរ លើកុំព្យូទ័រ និងទូរស័ព្ទ សំណើ និងឧបករណ៍របស់វា វិក្កយបត្រជាភាសាអង់គ្លេស ជាមួយសរុបជាប្រាក់រៀល និងកូដ KHQR វិក្កយបត្រអាករជាភាសាខ្មែរ និងអង់គ្លេស និងផ្នែកគ្រប់គ្រងជាភាសាបារាំង។

en: The till
A tenth capture, taken on 26 November on the same local installation: the till, in French, open on its product screen with the three demo products, ready for a sale.
fr: La caisse
Une dixième capture, prise le 26 novembre sur la même installation locale : la caisse, en français, ouverte sur son écran de produits avec les trois produits de démonstration, prête pour une vente.
km: កន្លែងគិតលុយ
រូបថតអេក្រង់ទីដប់ ដែលថតនៅថ្ងៃទី 26 ខែវិច្ឆិកា លើការដំឡើងក្នុងម៉ាស៊ីនដដែល៖ កន្លែងគិតលុយ ជាភាសាបារាំង បើកលើអេក្រង់ផលិតផល ជាមួយផលិតផលសាកល្បងទាំងបី រួចរាល់សម្រាប់ការលក់។

en: A sale at the till

The till capture is taken again on 26 November with a sale in progress: two HDMI cables, a mouse and a USB key from the demo products, the taxes and a total of $22.83. The sale was not paid and the cart was emptied afterwards.
fr: Une vente à la caisse

La capture de la caisse est reprise le 26 novembre avec une vente en cours : deux câbles HDMI, une souris et une clé USB parmi les produits de démonstration, les taxes et un total de 22,83 $. La vente n’a pas été payée et le panier a été vidé ensuite.
km: ការលក់នៅកន្លែងគិតលុយ

រូបថតអេក្រង់កន្លែងគិតលុយត្រូវបានថតម្តងទៀតនៅថ្ងៃទី 26 ខែវិច្ឆិកា ជាមួយការលក់កំពុងដំណើរការ៖ ខ្សែ HDMI ពីរ កណ្តុរមួយ និងសោ USB មួយ ពីផលិតផលសាកល្បង ពន្ធ និងសរុប $22.83។ ការលក់នេះមិនត្រូវបានបង់ប្រាក់ទេ ហើយកន្ត្រកត្រូវបានសម្អាតបន្ទាប់មក។

en: Paying in riels

Two captures of the till’s payment, taken on 26 November: the payment screen, with the $22.83 total also given as 92,700 riels at 4,059 riels to the dollar, and cash in both currencies, where the client hands over $20 and 20,000 riels and the till gives back $2 and 400 riels. The payment was cancelled and nothing was recorded.
fr: Payer en riels

Deux captures du paiement à la caisse, prises le 26 novembre : l’écran de paiement, où le total de 22,83 $ est aussi donné en riels, 92 700 ៛ à 4 059 ៛ le dollar, et les espèces dans les deux monnaies, où le client donne 20 $ et 20 000 ៛ et la caisse rend 2 $ et 400 ៛.
